title: Saturation Function Set
description: Set of relative permeability and capillary pressure functions defining the content of the work-product-component SaturationFunctionSet.

SaturationFunctionSetID.title: Saturation Function Set ID
SaturationFunctionSetID.description: A reference back to the work product component SaturationFunctionSet record, to which the content belongs.

RelativePermeabilityFunctions.title: Relative Permeability Functions
RelativePermeabilityFunctions.description: Set of relative permeability values as a function of saturation in two-, or three-phase systems for drainage and/or imbibition processes.

items.title: Relative Permeability Functions
items.description: Set of relative permeability values as a function of saturation in two-, or three-phase systems for drainage and/or imbibition processes.

FunctionUsageTypeID.title: Function Usage Type ID
FunctionUsageTypeID.description: Identifies the type of usage for which the function is designed (such as imbibition, drainage, etc)

PhaseRelativePermeabilityFunctions.title: Phase Relative Permeability Functions
PhaseRelativePermeabilityFunctions.description: Set of relative permeability functions of fluid phases present in the reservoir as a function of a saturation.

items.title: Phase Relative Permeability Function
items.description: Relative permeability of a fluid phase (oil, water, gas) as a function of saturation.

Saturation.title: Saturation
Saturation.description: Saturation values for which the relative permeabilities are tabulated.

RelativePermeability.title: Relative Permeability
RelativePermeability.description: Relative permeability values of the fluid phase at the corresponding saturation values.

PhaseRelativePermeabilityFluidID.title: Phase Relative Permeability Fluid ID
PhaseRelativePermeabilityFluidID.description: Identifies the fluid phase that the relative permeability characterizes.

PhaseSaturationFluidID.title: Phase Saturation Fluid ID
PhaseSaturationFluidID.description: Identifies the fluid phase that is being used for the saturation.

CapillaryPressureFunctions.title: Capillary Pressure Functions
CapillaryPressureFunctions.description: Set of capillary pressure values as function of saturation in two-, or three-phase systems for drainage and/or imbibition processes.

items.title: Capillary Pressure Functions
items.description: Set of capillary pressure values as a function of saturation in two-, or three-phase systems for drainage and/or imbibition processes.

FunctionUsageTypeID.title: Function Usage Type ID
FunctionUsageTypeID.description: Identifies the type of usage for which the function is designed (such as imbibition, drainage, etc).

PhaseCapillaryPressureFunctions.title: Phase Capillary Pressure Functions
PhaseCapillaryPressureFunctions.description: Set of capillary pressure functions of fluid phases present in the reservoir as a function of a saturation.

items.title: Phase Capillary Pressure Function
items.description: Capillary Pressure of a fluid phase (oil, water, gas) as a function of saturation.

Saturation.title: Saturation
Saturation.description: Saturation values for which the capillary pressures are tabulated.

CapillaryPressure.title: Capillary Pressure
CapillaryPressure.description: Capillary Pressure values of the fluid phase at the corresponding saturation values.

PhaseCapillaryPressureFluidID.title: Phase Capillary Pressure Fluid ID
PhaseCapillaryPressureFluidID.description: Identifies the fluid phase that refers to the capillary pressure.

PhaseSaturationFluidID.title: Phase Saturation Fluid ID
PhaseSaturationFluidID.description: Identifies the fluid phase that is being used for the saturation.
